card.name: Words right before the word tablet
card.fires_on: Numbers, articles or colour and flavour words that sit directly before the word "tablet" in dosing directions. It fires on the word that makes "tablet" the likely next word.

modes.label: Count before tablet
modes.description: A number such as one, 1 or a closing bracket after (1) right before "tablet" in dose instructions.

modes.description: "the", or a colour or flavour word, right before "tablet" in handling or pack instructions.
